parsed.post: Huge jump! 0.9969 with DEPTH=6 and LR=0.03. It seems a lower learning rate actually helps converge much deeper into the local minima at this depth. I'll try adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 and WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 now to see if that regularization/stability helps maintain this gain.
parsed.description: Adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 and WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 to the current best low-LR configuration (DEPTH=6, LR=0.03).
